consumer_rule.index_semantics: UNBOUND; preserve observed differences across runs
consumer_rule.projection: selected native record is projected into a separate 15-word local structure
consumer_rule.selection: explicit row-index input selects table-B base plus i times 52 bytes

collection_semantics.comparison: signed integer comparison against the node's single element field
collection_semantics.ordinal_access: in-order tree walk returns that same element

conversion.mapping_source: static converter in the selected DLL
conversion.operation: native code normalization through a switch

producer_source.native_owner: selected SymphonyRenderer task-config ordered set, copied into SpatialCoder configuration
producer_source.source_entry_selection: in-order set element by ordinal i; the table writer requests the i-th element
producer_source.source_scalar_access: ordinal getter returns the single 32-bit set element stored at the tree node element field

table_b_writer_rule.destination: table-B row i, one native metadata-code field
table_b_writer_rule.row_index: i from 0 up to constructor table-B count minus one
table_b_writer_rule.source_set_guard: write converted code only when i is less than ordered-set element count
table_b_writer_rule.source_value: one signed 32-bit set element returned by in-order ordinal access
